Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

develop verb

grow, make progress

also grow, progress, make progress, come on, advance, evolve, evolve gradually, make headway, we are making some headway

classical

Sen. Ep. 76.5: ‘quantum’ inquis ‘prōficiam?’ quantum temptāveris
Quint. 10.1.112: ille sē prōfēcisse sciat, cui Cicerō valdē placēbit
Caes. BG 7.20: sī nihil in oppugnātiōne oppidī prōfēcisset (Lewis & Short)
Traupman p. 100: ut spērō, prōficimus aliquantum

prōficiō, prōficere, prōfēcī, prōfectum

verb, third conjugation

make progress, get on

Of a person’s progress in learning, a skill or a task.

Other words

  • adolēscō, adolēscere, adolēvī, adultum — grow up, grow to maturity

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 3.2: sēmina innāta virtūtum, quae sī adolēscere licēret

    Of natural growth: children, plants, and the seeds of a talent.

  • crēscō, crēscere, crēvī, crētum — grow

    verb, third conjugation, intransitive · also used · classical · Liv. 1.8.4: crēscēbat interim urbs

  • prōcēdō, prōcēdere, prōcessī, prōcessum — go forward; go well

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Pers. 114–115: id tōtum prōcēdit diem

    Of how an undertaking goes on.

Examples

  • sunt enim ingeniīs nostrīs sēmina innāta virtūtum, quae sī adolēscere licēret, ipsa nōs ad beātam vītam nātūra perdūceret

    for the seeds of the virtues are born in our nature, and if they were allowed to develop, nature herself would lead us to a happy lifeCic. Tusc. 3.2

  • ‘quantum’ inquis ‘prōficiam?’ quantum temptāveris

    ‘how far will I get?’ you ask. As far as you trySen. Ep. 76.5

  • Ut spērō, prōficimus aliquantum.

    We are making some headway, I hope.Traupman p. 100

See also develop, increase, development.
